scope: Handle malformed Gemini usage metadata before recording a decision or starting payment.
reproduction: Four malformed usage values raised uncaught AttributeError before the patch.
change: Parse usage metadata inside the existing guarded response parser.
checks: Null, list, string, and numeric usage values return gemini_invalid_response without recording decisions.
Missing optional metadata remains valid. Usage records retain integer values and exclude booleans.
The trade command returns an error without constructing the worker or making payment requests.
limits: Synthetic responses exercise malformed metadata. No actual provider response was changed.
This check does not grant independent review acceptance, G4 acceptance, G5 acceptance, or production eligibility.
